name: Jayaratha (Rajanaka)
summary: The great scholiast: his Viveka commentary (12 vols KSTS with root) establishes Krama/Trika readings — incl. the long controversy settling Lakshmanagupta's Krama+Trikaship. Also Vimarshini on Ruyyaka's Alankarasarvasva (poetics).
bio: Great scholiast (c. 1225-1275): the Viveka commentary (12 KSTS vols with root) establishes Krama+Trikaship against controversy; also Vimarshini on Ruyyaka's Alankarasarvasva.
